texte:
Hello, it's me
I was wondering if after all these years
You'd like to meet
To go over everything...

There ain't no gold in this river
That I've been washin' my hands in forever
I know there is hope in these waters
But I can't bring myself to swim...

There's a fire starting in my heart
Reaching a fever pitch and it's bringing me out the dark
Finally I can see you crystal clear...

I heard that you're settled down
That you found a girl and you're married now
I heard that your dreams came true...

J'ai bu la nuit, j'ai bu le jour
Je t'ai cherché dans les détours
Impala, Impala...

Je t'aime encore, je t'aime toujours
Même quand la nuit efface le jour
Je t'aime encore...

These are your friends
They'll be with you 'til the end
They'll be with you when you're down...

Your ringtone, your ringtone
I hear it in my sleep
Your ringtone, your ringtone...

You won't break my soul
You won't break my soul
I'm tellin' everybody
Everybody...

I feel like fallin' in love
I'm in the mood to fuck somethin' up
I need a real one, baby...

Y'all haters corny with that Illuminati mess
Paparazzi, catch my fly, and my cocky fresh...

Hold up, they don't love you like I love you
Slow down, they don't love you like I love you...

All these accidents
That happen
Follow the dots
And I'm ready to go...

I'm a fountain of blood
In the shape of a girl
I'm the bird on the brim
Of the holy water...

Damn, dis-moi, dis-moi
Comment tu fais pour rester comme ça
Damn, dis-moi...

Je marche, je marche
Je marche pour toi
Dans les rues de la ville...

One more time, we're gonna celebrate
Oh yeah, all right, don't stop the dancing
One more time...

Work it harder, make it better
Do it faster, makes us stronger
More than ever, hour after hour
Work is never over...

Like the legend of the phoenix
All ends with beginnings
What keeps the planet spinning
A force from the beginning...

One more time, I'm gonna be the one
I'm gonna hold you, I'm gonna be the one
And I feel like I'm the one...

I, I wish you could swim
Like the dolphins, like dolphins can swim
Though nothing, nothing will keep us together...

Beauty and the beast
They're from the same world
Somewhere between the two...

Did a full 180, crazy
Thinkin' 'bout the way I was
Did the heartbreak change me? Maybe...

If you wanna run away with me
I know a galaxy and I can take you for a ride
I had a premonition that we fell into a rhythm...
